title: Kecksburg crash witnesses saw people in moon suits

tellings.quote: know, if you think back to the 1965 Kexsburg, Pennsylvania crash, all the witnesses on on SE scene said they saw people in what they called moon suits

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, recalls a reported crash of an unknown object near Kecksburg, a small town in Pennsylvania, in 1965. According to UAPGerb, all the witnesses at the scene said they saw people in what they called moon suits, which he raises as a sign that an organised recovery team came for whatever fell.
